imageQA.sourceComparison: Codex visual review of all seven final contact sheets and source layouts; two QR tiles excluded; two multi-instrument composites split into five separate row photos; ambiguous 607 composite retained only as a general subgroup illustration
imageQA.nativeLimits: Every source photo has recorded final native dimensions; exact-2x Real-ESRGAN before rembg; cutouts have 32px transparent padding

sceneFallbacks.reason: Original source scene retained after U2NetP and ISNet left background artifacts inside the ring

sourceCatalogCorrections.issue: Source prints REF 020940003 for 150° / 3 holes / 89 mm and again for 140° / 4 holes / 105 mm. Owner directed retention of one best-supported row. Retained the 150° row: it follows the 02091/02092/02093/02094 angle series; omitted the second row from the product table. Original evidence remains in the internal OCR audit. The manufacturer has not confirmed the omitted row’s REF.
Index places Patella Pin Instrument Set at 11/4; actual set pages are 11/6–11/7 (PDF 616–617). Actual source pages imported; no product values changed.
